connector.name: MCP Server by instavar.com
connector.registryDescription: Drive Instavar Studio video jobs (create, render, approve, publish, metrics) with an API key.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.instavar, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: INSTAVAR_API_KEY
env.description: Per-user API key from https://instavar.com/studio/settings. Scoped to your org and revocable.

env.name: INSTAVAR_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the Instavar API host. Defaults to https://instavar.com.
